name: FlexFactory Orchestrator
description: Web4 agent that manages predictive maintenance, procurement and production rebalancing for a VeriWork factory digital twin. Twin state is ZK-attested on the VeriWork L2.

skills.name: Predictive maintenance
skills.description: Detects degrading machines from ZK-attested twin states and schedules escrowed service orders.

skills.name: Parts procurement
skills.description: Issues supplier orders paid over x402 when inventory drops below reorder points.

skills.name: Inter-factory credit exchange
skills.description: Quotes and executes bonding-curve credit swaps on the VeriWork credit market.
